summary: Mother of André Lamoureux, of Cozes in France; John's 10th-great-grandmother.
bio: Marie Touchay lived at Cozes, where she appears as a godparent alongside Daniel Lamoureux in 1656. She was the mother of André Lamoureux, who was baptized at Cozes on 25 November 1663. She is probably John's 10th-great-grandmother.
sources: Kenn True Garner, The French Reformed Church, Cozes, Saintonge: Baptisms 1655-1668 (FamilySearch Books); FHL film 1868505 item 5
